messages.subject: Conflicting libraries?
parts:
Hi there,

I just updated all the R libraries in an install on a redhat (rhel5)
machine and now the geom_smooth (loess) is producing a graph that is
incorrect. So, this must be caused by an update of an R library that
is conflicting with ggplot. Any ideas/knowledge about this problem?

Thanks!
Leo

works fine with version 1.03)

Cheers,
Leo
